dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Titans (1-9) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Jaguars
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Tennessee opened G Fernando Carmona's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for DE John Franklin-Myers (back). S Terrell Burgess (knee), OT Dan Moore Jr. (knee), and CB Cor'Dale Flott (neck) did not practice Wednesday, while G Fernando Carmona (ankle (sprain)) and TE Kylen Granson (ankle) practiced in full [tennesseetitans.com Official](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/news/week-12-injury-report-titans-at-jaguars).

Week 12 Jaguars Outlook: Robert Saleh and DC Gus Bradley open installation for the Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3, JAX -14.5, HC Liam Coen, OC Grant Udinski & DC Anthony Campanile (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Def. EPA Allowed / Game (-5.86) as Tennessee prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Turron Davenport](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4429607/cordale-flott#:~:text=Flott%20%28neck%29%20did%20not%20participate%20in%20Wednesday's) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873090).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 1-9 (4th in AFC South • #16 Seed in AFC), Tennessee carries a 0% postseason projection, 0% AFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [tennesseetitans.com Official](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/news/quick-hits-on-the-titans-from-wednesday-of-jaguars-week-x6564).

Around the Beat: The Titans returned to the practice field on Wednesday at Vanderbilt Health Football Center to continue preparations for Sunday's game at the Jacksonville Jaguars [tennesseetitans.com Official](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/news/quick-hits-on-the-titans-from-wednesday-of-jaguars-week-x6564).
